changes_made.issue_claim: the discussion-draft PDF itself is distributed via the committee but is not yet indexed on the committee's public documents page at a stable URL
changes_made.new_content: Added the primary source URL https://docs.house.gov/meetings/BA/BA00/20260317/119049/BILLS-119pih-makesimprovementstoTitleVoftheGLBAt.pdf to the Executive Summary, Key Provisions lead-in, §503A bullet, Procedural Status section, and the Sources list as source #1. Removed the Verification Notes section entirely and rewrote the Procedural Status paragraph to cite the PDF directly (including the 'H. R. ll' placeholder-number observation).

changes_made.issue_claim: The draft also contains §503A consumer access/deletion rights and an expanded NPI definition (biometric, geolocation, access credentials) not mentioned in the report.
changes_made.new_content: Added two new bullets to Key Provisions: (1) 'Expanded definition of NPI' covering biometric data, geolocation, and access credentials; (2) 'New §503A consumer access and deletion rights' covering right to obtain NPI, categories of recipients, and post-relationship deletion with FCRA/legal exceptions. Also updated Executive Summary to mention these new rights, refined the data-aggregator bullet to reflect the formal 'financial data aggregator' definition and carve-outs, and expanded Impact Analysis and Action Items to address BIPA-style biometric exposure and §503A DSAR workflows.
